3700_cond_gateway@All/device_menu.label: Device Menu
3700_cond_gateway@All/device_menu.description: The analyzer menu is accessed through the connected SC Controller. On the SC4500, select the device tile then choose Device menu. On SC200/SC1000, go to the main menu then select SENSOR SETUP and select the analyzer.

3700_cond_gateway@All/device_menu.settin.label: Settings
3700_cond_gateway@All/device_menu.settin.description: Enter identification information for the sensor and change options for data handling and storage.

3700_cond_gateway@All/device_menu.settin.label: Name
3700_cond_gateway@All/device_menu.settin.description: Changes the name for the device at the top of the measurement screen; limited to 16 characters.

3700_cond_gateway@All/device_menu.settin.label: Measurement Type
3700_cond_gateway@All/device_menu.settin.description: Changes the measured parameter to Conductivity (default), Concentration, TDS or Salinity; changing the parameter resets all other settings to defaults.

3700_cond_gateway@All/device_menu.settin.label: Conductivity Unit
3700_cond_gateway@All/device_menu.settin.description: Changes the conductivity units to µS/cm (default), mS/cm or S/cm; only available when Measurement Type is set to Conductivity, Concentration or Salinity.

3700_cond_gateway@All/device_menu.settin.label: Cell Constant Parameters
3700_cond_gateway@All/device_menu.settin.description: Changes the cell constant to the actual certified K value from the label on the sensor cable; default: 4.70; only available when Measurement Type is set to Conductivity or Salinity.

3700_cond_gateway@All/device_menu.settin.label: Concentration Measurement
3700_cond_gateway@All/device_menu.settin.description: Sets the type of concentration table to use — Built-in (default) or User defined; only available when Measurement Type is set to Concentration.

3700_cond_gateway@All/device_menu.settin.label: TDS (Total Dissolved Solids)
3700_cond_gateway@All/device_menu.settin.description: Sets the factor used to convert conductivity to TDS — NaCl (default) or User defined; only available when Measurement Type is set to TDS.

3700_cond_gateway@All/device_menu.settin.label: Temperature
3700_cond_gateway@All/device_menu.settin.description: Sets the temperature units to °C (default) or °F.

3700_cond_gateway@All/device_menu.settin.label: T-compensation
3700_cond_gateway@All/device_menu.settin.description: Adds a temperature-dependent correction to the measured value — None, Linear (default: 2.0%/°C, 25 °C), Natural water, or Temperature compensation table.

3700_cond_gateway@All/device_menu.settin.label: Data Logger Interval
3700_cond_gateway@All/device_menu.settin.description: Sets the time interval for sensor and temperature measurement storage in the data log — Disabled (default), 5, 10, 15, 30 seconds, 1, 5, 10, 15, 30 minutes or 1, 2, 6, 12 hours.

3700_cond_gateway@All/device_menu.settin.label: Alternating Current Frequency
3700_cond_gateway@All/device_menu.settin.description: Selects the power line frequency for best noise rejection — 50 or 60 Hz (default).

3700_cond_gateway@All/device_menu.settin.label: Filter
3700_cond_gateway@All/device_menu.settin.description: Sets a time constant (0 to 60 seconds, default 0) to calculate a rolling average and increase signal stability.

3700_cond_gateway@All/device_menu.settin.label: Temperature Element
3700_cond_gateway@All/device_menu.settin.description: Sets the temperature element for automatic temperature compensation to PT1000 (default) or Manual.

3700_cond_gateway@All/device_menu.settin.label: Last Calibration
3700_cond_gateway@All/device_menu.settin.description: Sets a reminder for the next calibration (default: 60 days); a reminder shows on the display after the selected interval from the date of the last calibration.

3700_cond_gateway@All/device_menu.settin.label: Sensor Days
3700_cond_gateway@All/device_menu.settin.description: Sets a reminder for sensor replacement (default: 365 days); a reminder shows on the display after the selected interval.

3700_cond_gateway@All/device_menu.settin.label: Reset Setup
3700_cond_gateway@All/device_menu.settin.description: Sets the Settings menu to factory defaults and resets all counters; all device information is lost.

3700_cond_gateway@All/device_menu.calibr.label: Calibration
3700_cond_gateway@All/device_menu.calibr.description: Calibration options for the inductive conductivity sensor connected to an sc digital gateway.

3700_cond_gateway@All/device_menu.calibr.label: Zero Calibration (0-point Calibration)
3700_cond_gateway@All/device_menu.calibr.description: Defines the unique zero point of the conductivity sensor by holding the dry sensor in air; must be completed before calibrating with a reference solution for the first time.

3700_cond_gateway@All/device_menu.calibr.label: Conductivity Calibration
3700_cond_gateway@All/device_menu.calibr.description: Calibrates conductivity using a reference solution or process sample with a secondary verification instrument; modifies calibration slope and/or offset.

3700_cond_gateway@All/device_menu.calibr.label: TDS Calibration
3700_cond_gateway@All/device_menu.calibr.description: Calibrates the TDS measurement using a process sample with a secondary verification instrument.

3700_cond_gateway@All/device_menu.calibr.label: Concentration Calibration
3700_cond_gateway@All/device_menu.calibr.description: Calibrates the concentration measurement using a process sample with a secondary verification instrument.

3700_cond_gateway@All/device_menu.calibr.label: 1-Point Temperature Calibration (Temperature Adjustment)
3700_cond_gateway@All/device_menu.calibr.description: Calibrates the temperature measurement by entering the exact temperature of a reference water sample.

3700_cond_gateway@All/device_menu.calibr.label: Reset to Calibration Defaults (Reset Setup)
3700_cond_gateway@All/device_menu.calibr.description: Resets the calibration to factory default settings; all sensor calibration information is lost.

3700_cond_gateway@All/device_menu.diagno.label: Diagnostics
3700_cond_gateway@All/device_menu.diagno.description: Shows current and historical information about the sensor.

3700_cond_gateway@All/device_menu.diagno.label: Sensor Information
3700_cond_gateway@All/device_menu.diagno.description: Shows the sensor model number, serial number, software version and driver version installed.

3700_cond_gateway@All/device_menu.diagno.label: Calibration History
3700_cond_gateway@All/device_menu.diagno.description: Shows the cell constant parameters, offset correction and date of the last calibration.

3700_cond_gateway@All/device_menu.diagno.label: Sensor Days
3700_cond_gateway@All/device_menu.diagno.description: Shows the number of days the sensor has been in operation.

3700_cond_gateway@All/device_menu.diagno.label: Reset
3700_cond_gateway@All/device_menu.diagno.description: Resets the Sensor Days counter to zero; reset when the sensor is replaced.

3700_cond_gateway@All/device_menu.diagno.label: Sensor Signal
3700_cond_gateway@All/device_menu.diagno.description: Shows the current measurement analog-to-digital converter counter; allows setting the sensor range (default: 6).

3700_cond_module@All/device_menu.label: Device menu
3700_cond_module@All/device_menu.description: The analyzer menu is accessed through the connected SC Controller. On the SC4500, select the device tile then choose Device menu. On SC200/SC1000, go to the main menu then select SENSOR SETUP and select the analyzer.

3700_cond_module@All/device_menu.setting.label: Settings
3700_cond_module@All/device_menu.setting.description: Enter identification information for the sensor and change options for data handling and storage.

3700_cond_module@All/device_menu.setting.label: Name
3700_cond_module@All/device_menu.setting.description: Changes the name for the device at the top of the measurement screen; limited to 16 characters.

3700_cond_module@All/device_menu.setting.label: Sensor S/N
3700_cond_module@All/device_menu.setting.description: Lets the user enter the serial number of the sensor; limited to 16 characters.

3700_cond_module@All/device_menu.setting.label: Measurement Type
3700_cond_module@All/device_menu.setting.description: Changes the measured parameter to Conductivity (default), Concentration, TDS or Salinity; changing the parameter resets all other settings to defaults.

3700_cond_module@All/device_menu.setting.label: Format
3700_cond_module@All/device_menu.setting.description: Changes the number of decimal places shown on the measurement screen to Auto, X.XXX, XX.XX or XXX.X.

3700_cond_module@All/device_menu.setting.label: Conductivity Unit
3700_cond_module@All/device_menu.setting.description: Changes the conductivity units to Auto, µS/cm, mS/cm or S/cm; only available when Measurement Type is set to Conductivity or Concentration.

3700_cond_module@All/device_menu.setting.label: Temperature
3700_cond_module@All/device_menu.setting.description: Sets the temperature units to °C (default) or °F.

3700_cond_module@All/device_menu.setting.label: T-compensation
3700_cond_module@All/device_menu.setting.description: Adds a temperature-dependent correction to the measured value — None, Linear (default: 2.0%/°C, 25 °C), Natural water, or Temperature compensation table.

3700_cond_module@All/device_menu.setting.label: Concentration Measurement
3700_cond_module@All/device_menu.setting.description: Sets the type of concentration table to use — Built-in (default) or User compensation table; only available when Measurement Type is set to Concentration.

3700_cond_module@All/device_menu.setting.label: TDS (Total Dissolved Solids)
3700_cond_module@All/device_menu.setting.description: Sets the factor used to convert conductivity to TDS — NaCl (default) or Custom; only available when Measurement Type is set to TDS.

3700_cond_module@All/device_menu.setting.label: Temperature Element
3700_cond_module@All/device_menu.setting.description: Sets the temperature element for automatic temperature compensation to PT100, PT1000 (default) or Manual.

3700_cond_module@All/device_menu.setting.label: Cell Constant Parameters
3700_cond_module@All/device_menu.setting.description: Changes the cell constant to the actual certified K value from the label on the sensor cable; default: 4.70.

3700_cond_module@All/device_menu.setting.label: Filter
3700_cond_module@All/device_menu.setting.description: Sets a time constant (0 to 200 seconds, default 0) to calculate a rolling average and increase signal stability.

3700_cond_module@All/device_menu.setting.label: Data Logger Interval
3700_cond_module@All/device_menu.setting.description: Sets the time interval for sensor and temperature measurement storage in the data log — 5 or 30 seconds, or 1, 2, 5, 10, 15 (default), 30 or 60 minutes.

3700_cond_module@All/device_menu.setting.label: Reset Settings to Default Values
3700_cond_module@All/device_menu.setting.description: Sets the Settings menu to factory defaults and resets all counters; all device information is lost.

3700_cond_module@All/device_menu.calibra.label: Calibration
3700_cond_module@All/device_menu.calibra.description: Calibration options for the inductive conductivity sensor connected to a conductivity module.

3700_cond_module@All/device_menu.calibra.label: Calibration Options
3700_cond_module@All/device_menu.calibra.description: Sets calibration reminders and operator ID options; not applicable to sensors connected to an sc digital gateway.

3700_cond_module@All/device_menu.calibra.label: Calibration Reminder
3700_cond_module@All/device_menu.calibra.description: Sets a reminder interval for the next calibration (default: Off); a reminder shows on the display after the selected interval from the date of the last calibration.

3700_cond_module@All/device_menu.calibra.label: Operator ID for Calibration
3700_cond_module@All/device_menu.calibra.description: Includes an operator ID with calibration data — Yes or No (default); the ID is entered during calibration.

3700_cond_module@All/device_menu.calibra.label: Zero Calibration
3700_cond_module@All/device_menu.calibra.description: Defines the unique zero point of the conductivity sensor; must be completed before calibrating with a reference solution for the first time.

3700_cond_module@All/device_menu.calibra.label: Conductivity Solution
3700_cond_module@All/device_menu.calibra.description: Calibrates the sensor by matching its reading to a reference solution of known conductivity value; modifies the calibration slope and/or offset.

3700_cond_module@All/device_menu.calibra.label: Conductivity Calibration
3700_cond_module@All/device_menu.calibra.description: Calibrates the sensor using the process sample with a secondary verification instrument.

3700_cond_module@All/device_menu.calibra.label: 1-Point Temperature Calibration
3700_cond_module@All/device_menu.calibra.description: Calibrates the temperature measurement by entering the exact temperature of a reference water sample.

3700_cond_module@All/device_menu.calibra.label: Reset to Default Calibration Values
3700_cond_module@All/device_menu.calibra.description: Resets the calibration to factory default settings; all sensor calibration information is lost.

3700_cond_module@All/device_menu.diagnos.label: Diagnostics
3700_cond_module@All/device_menu.diagnos.description: Shows current and historical information about the sensor.

3700_cond_module@All/device_menu.diagnos.label: Module Information
3700_cond_module@All/device_menu.diagnos.description: Shows the version and serial number of the conductivity module.

3700_cond_module@All/device_menu.diagnos.label: Sensor Information
3700_cond_module@All/device_menu.diagnos.description: Shows the sensor name and the serial number entered by the user.

3700_cond_module@All/device_menu.diagnos.label: Last Calibration
3700_cond_module@All/device_menu.diagnos.description: Shows the number of days since the last calibration was completed.

3700_cond_module@All/device_menu.diagnos.label: Calibration History
3700_cond_module@All/device_menu.diagnos.description: Shows the calibration slope and date of previous calibrations.

3700_cond_module@All/device_menu.diagnos.label: Sensor Signals
3700_cond_module@All/device_menu.diagnos.description: Shows the current conductivity and temperature reading.

3700_cond_module@All/device_menu.diagnos.label: Sensor Days
3700_cond_module@All/device_menu.diagnos.description: Shows the number of days the sensor has been in operation.

3700_cond_module@All/device_menu.diagnos.label: Reset
3700_cond_module@All/device_menu.diagnos.description: Sets the Sensor Days counter to zero; reset when the sensor is replaced.

nh6000sc@Latest/configuration.label: Configuration
nh6000sc@Latest/configuration.description: Configure measurement parameters, intervals, outputs, and cleaning for the analyzer.

nh6000sc@Latest/configuration.name.label: Name
nh6000sc@Latest/configuration.name.description: Changes the name of the analyzer (up to 16 characters: letters, numbers, spaces, or punctuation).

nh6000sc@Latest/configuration.parameter.label: Parameter
nh6000sc@Latest/configuration.parameter.description: Selects the measured parameter shown on the display.

nh6000sc@Latest/configuration.unit.label: Unit
nh6000sc@Latest/configuration.unit.description: Selects the measurement unit shown on the display.

nh6000sc@Latest/configuration.measuremen.label: Measurement Range
nh6000sc@Latest/configuration.measuremen.description: Selects the applicable measurement range; changing the range requires installing the corresponding standard solutions and electrolyte.

nh6000sc@Latest/configuration.output_mod.label: Output Mode
nh6000sc@Latest/configuration.output_mod.description: Sets the values shown on the analog outputs when the analyzer is in maintenance mode.

nh6000sc@Latest/configuration.output_mod.label: Hold — analog outputs retain the latest measured value
Active — analog outputs continue to show the measured parameter
Transfer — sets analog outputs to the configured Transfer value

nh6000sc@Latest/configuration.measuremen.label: Measurement Interval
nh6000sc@Latest/configuration.measuremen.description: Selects the measurement interval; the recommended default of 10 minutes keeps the maintenance interval at half a year.

nh6000sc@Latest/configuration.sampling.label: Sampling
nh6000sc@Latest/configuration.sampling.description: Sets the channel for the sample filtration system to On or Off.

nh6000sc@Latest/configuration.cleaning.label: Cleaning
nh6000sc@Latest/configuration.cleaning.description: Shows the start time of the next cleaning and configures automatic cleaning settings.

nh6000sc@Latest/configuration.cleaning.c.label: Cleaning Start Time
nh6000sc@Latest/configuration.cleaning.c.description: Sets the start time for the automatic cleaning cycle.

nh6000sc@Latest/configuration.cleaning.c.label: Cleaning Iterval
nh6000sc@Latest/configuration.cleaning.c.description: Sets the automatic cleaning interval; the recommended default of 48 hours keeps the maintenance interval at half a year.

nh6000sc@Latest/configuration.cleaning.e.label: Extended Cleaning
nh6000sc@Latest/configuration.cleaning.e.description: Sets the cleaning procedure of the overflow vessel and sample drain tubing to On or Off; manufacturer recommends Off when a Nitratax sc or NT3100sc sensor is the last device in a cascaded installation.

nh6000sc@Latest/configuration.seasonal_h.label: Seasonal Heating
nh6000sc@Latest/configuration.seasonal_h.description: Selects the starting and ending month for the operating time of the heated drain tubing.

nh6000sc@Latest/configuration.sample_flo.label: Sample Flow Warning
nh6000sc@Latest/configuration.sample_flo.description: Sets the warning level for sample flow (400–1400 mL/h; default 600 mL/h); a warning appears when sample flow decreases below this threshold.

nh6000sc@Latest/configuration.maintenanc.label: Maintenance Reminder
nh6000sc@Latest/configuration.maintenanc.description: Sets the number of days before maintenance is due when a reminder is shown on the display.

nh6000sc@Latest/configuration.out_of_ran.label: Out of Range Warning
nh6000sc@Latest/configuration.out_of_ran.description: Sets the warning for low and high out-of-range measurement values to On or Off.

nh6000sc@Latest/configuration.reset_to_d.label: Reset to Defaults
nh6000sc@Latest/configuration.reset_to_d.description: Sets all configuration settings to factory defaults; measurement range and counters are not reset.

nh6000sc@Latest/configuration.channel_1.label: Channel 1
nh6000sc@Latest/configuration.channel_1.description: Settings specific to Channel 1 on a 2-channel analyzer.

nh6000sc@Latest/configuration.channel_1..label: Ch1 Location
nh6000sc@Latest/configuration.channel_1..description: Changes the name of the Channel 1 location (up to 16 characters).

nh6000sc@Latest/configuration.channel_1..label: Ch1 Parameter
nh6000sc@Latest/configuration.channel_1..description: Selects the measured parameter shown for Channel 1.

nh6000sc@Latest/configuration.channel_1..label: Ch1 Number of Measurements
nh6000sc@Latest/configuration.channel_1..description: Sets the number of measurements for Channel 1.

nh6000sc@Latest/configuration.channel_1..label: Ch1 Discard Measurements
nh6000sc@Latest/configuration.channel_1..description: Sets the number of measurements discarded after a channel change and before actual measurements start for Channel 1.

nh6000sc@Latest/configuration.channel_1..label: Ch1 Sampling Configuration
nh6000sc@Latest/configuration.channel_1..description: Sets Channel 1 to internal or external filtration system.

nh6000sc@Latest/configuration.channel_2.label: Channel 2
nh6000sc@Latest/configuration.channel_2.description: Settings specific to Channel 2 on a 2-channel analyzer.

nh6000sc@Latest/configuration.channel_2..label: Ch2 Location
nh6000sc@Latest/configuration.channel_2..description: Changes the name of the Channel 2 location (up to 16 characters).

nh6000sc@Latest/configuration.channel_2..label: Ch2 Parameter
nh6000sc@Latest/configuration.channel_2..description: Selects the measured parameter shown for Channel 2.

nh6000sc@Latest/configuration.channel_2..label: Ch2 Number of Measurements
nh6000sc@Latest/configuration.channel_2..description: Sets the number of measurements for Channel 2.

nh6000sc@Latest/configuration.channel_2..label: Ch2 Discard Measurements
nh6000sc@Latest/configuration.channel_2..description: Sets the number of measurements discarded after a channel change and before actual measurements start for Channel 2.

nh6000sc@Latest/calibration.label: Calibration
nh6000sc@Latest/calibration.description: Configure and start calibration cycles using two standards to calculate offset and slope.

nh6000sc@Latest/calibration.next_calibra.label: Next Calibration
nh6000sc@Latest/calibration.next_calibra.description: Shows the date and time when the next scheduled calibration will start.

nh6000sc@Latest/calibration.automatic_ca.label: Auto Cal Start Time
nh6000sc@Latest/calibration.automatic_ca.description: Sets the time at which the automatic calibration cycle starts.

nh6000sc@Latest/calibration.automatic_ca.label: Auto Cal interval
nh6000sc@Latest/calibration.automatic_ca.description: Sets the interval for automatic calibration; the recommended default of 48 hours keeps the maintenance interval at half a year.

nh6000sc@Latest/calibration.last_calibra.label: Last Calibration Value
nh6000sc@Latest/calibration.last_calibra.description: Shows the date, time, status, mV zero, mV standard 1 and 2, mV slope, and mV offset of the most recent calibration.

nh6000sc@Latest/calibration.grab_sample.label: Grab Sample
nh6000sc@Latest/calibration.grab_sample.description: Starts the automatic grab sample procedure (requires the optional grab sample accessory).

nh6000sc@Latest/calibration.grab_sample..label: Start Grab Sample
nh6000sc@Latest/calibration.grab_sample..description: Fills a grab sample bottle with sample and records the measurement.

nh6000sc@Latest/calibration.grab_sample..label: Last Grab Sample
nh6000sc@Latest/calibration.grab_sample..description: Shows the date, time, and value of the most recent grab sample.

nh6000sc@Latest/calibration.validation.label: Validation
nh6000sc@Latest/calibration.validation.description: Starts the automatic validation procedure (requires the optional validation accessory).

nh6000sc@Latest/calibration.validation.s.label: Start Validation
nh6000sc@Latest/calibration.validation.s.description: Pre-pumps, flushes, and measures the installed standard solution three times.

nh6000sc@Latest/calibration.validation.l.label: Last Validation
nh6000sc@Latest/calibration.validation.l.description: Shows the date, time, and value of the most recent validation.

nh6000sc@Latest/calibration.factor.label: Factor
nh6000sc@Latest/calibration.factor.description: Sets the slope factor to adjust the standard calibration (range: 0.500–2.000; default: 1.000).

nh6000sc@Latest/calibration.offset.label: Offset
nh6000sc@Latest/calibration.offset.description: Sets the offset value to adjust the standard calibration (range: –5.00 to 5.00 mg/L; default: 0.00).

nh6000sc@Latest/calibration.cal_reset_to.label: Cal Reset to Defaults
nh6000sc@Latest/calibration.cal_reset_to.description: Sets all calibration settings to factory defaults.

nh6000sc@Latest/calibration.channel_1_co.label: Channel 1 Correction
nh6000sc@Latest/calibration.channel_1_co.description: Correction settings for Channel 1 on a 2-channel analyzer.

nh6000sc@Latest/calibration.channel_1_co.label: Ch1 Location Name
nh6000sc@Latest/calibration.channel_1_co.description: Shows the name of Channel 1 location.

nh6000sc@Latest/calibration.channel_1_co.label: Ch1 Factor
nh6000sc@Latest/calibration.channel_1_co.description: Sets the slope factor for Channel 1 (range: 0.500–2.000; default: 1.000).

nh6000sc@Latest/calibration.channel_1_co.label: Ch1 Offset
nh6000sc@Latest/calibration.channel_1_co.description: Sets the offset value for Channel 1 (range: –5.00 to 5.00 mg/L; default: 0.00).

nh6000sc@Latest/calibration.channel_2_co.label: Channel 2 Correction
nh6000sc@Latest/calibration.channel_2_co.description: Correction settings for Channel 2 on a 2-channel analyzer.

nh6000sc@Latest/calibration.channel_2_co.label: Ch2 Location Name
nh6000sc@Latest/calibration.channel_2_co.description: Shows the name of Channel 2 location.

nh6000sc@Latest/calibration.channel_2_co.label: Ch2 Factor
nh6000sc@Latest/calibration.channel_2_co.description: Sets the slope factor for Channel 2 (range: 0.500–2.000; default: 1.000).

nh6000sc@Latest/calibration.channel_2_co.label: Ch2 Offset
nh6000sc@Latest/calibration.channel_2_co.description: Sets the offset value for Channel 2 (range: –5.00 to 5.00 mg/L; default: 0.00).

nh6000sc@Latest/maintenance.label: Maintenance
nh6000sc@Latest/maintenance.description: Access maintenance workflows, replacement procedures, cleaning, and shutdown options.

nh6000sc@Latest/maintenance.current_stat.label: Current Status
nh6000sc@Latest/maintenance.current_stat.description: Shows the current operating status of the analyzer.

nh6000sc@Latest/maintenance.remaining_ti.label: Remaining Time
nh6000sc@Latest/maintenance.remaining_ti.description: Shows the time remaining in the current process.

nh6000sc@Latest/maintenance.start_mainte.label: Start Maintenance Mode
nh6000sc@Latest/maintenance.start_mainte.description: Toggles between maintenance mode and operational mode.

nh6000sc@Latest/maintenance.six_month_ma.label: Six Month Maintenance
nh6000sc@Latest/maintenance.six_month_ma.description: Starts the 6-month maintenance procedure (guided or non-guided) consolidating all necessary tasks; after completion all counters are automatically reset to zero.

nh6000sc@Latest/maintenance.six_month_ma.label: Start Guided
nh6000sc@Latest/maintenance.six_month_ma.description: Starts the 6-month maintenance with step-by-step on-screen instructions.

nh6000sc@Latest/maintenance.six_month_ma.label: Start Non Guided
nh6000sc@Latest/maintenance.six_month_ma.description: Starts the 6-month maintenance without on-screen instructions.

nh6000sc@Latest/maintenance.cleaning.label: Cleaning
nh6000sc@Latest/maintenance.cleaning.description: Cleaning procedures for the analyzer and sample system.

nh6000sc@Latest/maintenance.cleaning.aut.label: Automatic Cleaning
nh6000sc@Latest/maintenance.cleaning.aut.description: Starts an automatic cleaning procedure (approximately 30 minutes); flushes all tubing and parts with cleaning solution.

nh6000sc@Latest/maintenance.cleaning.fil.label: Filter Module Cleaning
nh6000sc@Latest/maintenance.cleaning.fil.description: Provides guidance for cleaning the filter modules of FX610 and FX620.

nh6000sc@Latest/maintenance.cleaning.cle.label: Clean Sample Tubing
nh6000sc@Latest/maintenance.cleaning.cle.description: Provides guidance for manually cleaning the sample tubing.

nh6000sc@Latest/maintenance.prepumping.label: Prepumping
nh6000sc@Latest/maintenance.prepumping.description: Starts prepumping options to prime tubing with the selected fluid.

nh6000sc@Latest/maintenance.replacement.label: Replacement
nh6000sc@Latest/maintenance.replacement.description: Individual maintenance replacement tasks with guided or non-guided instructions; counter resets to zero after each completed workflow.

nh6000sc@Latest/maintenance.replacement..label: Air Filter Pads
nh6000sc@Latest/maintenance.replacement..description: Replace the two air filter pads on the right side of the analyzer.

nh6000sc@Latest/maintenance.replacement..label: Standard Solutions 1 2
nh6000sc@Latest/maintenance.replacement..description: Replace standard solution 1 and standard solution 2 bottles.

nh6000sc@Latest/maintenance.replacement..label: Electrolyte Membrane
nh6000sc@Latest/maintenance.replacement..description: Replace the electrolyte and membrane cap of the gas-sensitive electrode.

nh6000sc@Latest/maintenance.replacement..label: Sample Pump Tubing
nh6000sc@Latest/maintenance.replacement..description: Replace the peristaltic sample pump tubing (optional; only for analyzers with internal filtration pump).

nh6000sc@Latest/maintenance.replacement..label: Filter Module
nh6000sc@Latest/maintenance.replacement..description: Replace the filter module (refer to FX610/FX620 user manual).

nh6000sc@Latest/maintenance.replacement..label: Piston Pump Head
nh6000sc@Latest/maintenance.replacement..description: Replace the piston pump head (recommended every 12 months).

nh6000sc@Latest/maintenance.air_tightnes.label: Air Tightness Test
nh6000sc@Latest/maintenance.air_tightnes.description: Starts an air tightness test to check for leaks in the piston pump system.

nh6000sc@Latest/maintenance.reset_errors.label: Reset Errors
nh6000sc@Latest/maintenance.reset_errors.description: Clears all active errors from the analyzer.

nh6000sc@Latest/maintenance.shutdown.label: Shutdown
nh6000sc@Latest/maintenance.shutdown.description: Options for taking the analyzer out of operation.

nh6000sc@Latest/maintenance.shutdown.shu.label: Shutdown Short
nh6000sc@Latest/maintenance.shutdown.shu.description: Puts the analyzer in shutdown mode for a short period (up to 2 days); no special draining measures required.

nh6000sc@Latest/maintenance.shutdown.ext.label: Extended Shutdown
nh6000sc@Latest/maintenance.shutdown.ext.description: Prepares the analyzer for extended shutdown or relocation by draining all chemicals and rinsing tubing with distilled water.

nh6000sc@Latest/diagnostics.label: Diagnostics
nh6000sc@Latest/diagnostics.description: View analyzer information, signal states, and maintenance counters.

nh6000sc@Latest/diagnostics.device_infor.label: Device Information
nh6000sc@Latest/diagnostics.device_infor.description: Shows device name, given name, location(s), measurement range, serial number, part number, and software/hardware versions.

nh6000sc@Latest/diagnostics.signals.label: Signals
nh6000sc@Latest/diagnostics.signals.description: Shows all functional condition signals of the analyzer.

nh6000sc@Latest/diagnostics.counters.label: Counters
nh6000sc@Latest/diagnostics.counters.description: Shows the number of days remaining until each maintenance task is due; counters reset when guided or non-guided maintenance workflows are completed.

an_ise_sc@Latest/sensor_setup.calibrate..label: VALUE CORR. 1

an_ise_sc@Latest/sensor_setup.calibrate..description: Enter the three values for the 1-point value correction.

an_ise_sc@Latest/sensor_setup.calibrate..description: Enter the displayed ammonium value from the probe.

cl17sc@Latest/device_menu.label: Device Menu

cl17sc@Latest/device_menu.settings.label: Settings
cl17sc@Latest/device_menu.settings.description: Configure the analyzer name, signal averaging, chlorine measurement type, bubble rejection, and alarm setpoints.

cl17sc@Latest/device_menu.settings.edit_.description: Sets the display name of the analyzer shown on the controller and in log files.

cl17sc@Latest/device_menu.settings.signa.description: Sets the number of consecutive measurements used to calculate the displayed average; options are 1 (averaging disabled), 2, 3, or Irregular Value (which rejects readings unusually higher or lower than recent values, holding the last good reading for up to three consecutive rejections).

cl17sc@Latest/device_menu.settings.measu.label: Measurement Type
cl17sc@Latest/device_menu.settings.measu.description: Sets the type of chlorine measured: Free Chlorine (default) or Total Chlorine — select to match the label on the installed reagent bottles.

cl17sc@Latest/device_menu.settings.bubbl.label: Bubble Reject
cl17sc@Latest/device_menu.settings.bubbl.description: Enables or disables bubble rejection (Yes/No, default No) to reduce signal noise caused by air bubbles in the sample.

cl17sc@Latest/device_menu.settings.high_.label: High Chlorine Alarm Limit
cl17sc@Latest/device_menu.settings.high_.description: Sets the chlorine concentration threshold that triggers a high chlorine alarm; range 0.00–10.00 mg/L (default 4.00 mg/L).

cl17sc@Latest/device_menu.settings.low_c.label: Low Chlorine Alarm Limit
cl17sc@Latest/device_menu.settings.low_c.description: Sets the chlorine concentration threshold that triggers a low chlorine alarm; range 0.00–10.00 mg/L (default 0.20 mg/L).

cl17sc@Latest/device_menu.settings.senso.label: Sensor Information
cl17sc@Latest/device_menu.settings.senso.description: Displays the analyzer serial number, software version, boot version, and driver version.

cl17sc@Latest/device_menu.settings.reset.label: Reset
cl17sc@Latest/device_menu.settings.reset.description: Select Yes to restore all configuration settings to factory default values.

cl17sc@Latest/device_menu.prime_reagents.label: Prime Reagents
cl17sc@Latest/device_menu.prime_reagents.description: Fills the reagent tubing and removes air from the lines; required after installation or reagent bottle replacement.

cl17sc@Latest/device_menu.grab_sample.label: Grab Sample
cl17sc@Latest/device_menu.grab_sample.description: Adds a water sample or chlorine standard solution directly to the cell for measurement, used to verify analyzer performance or measure a sample collected from another location.

cl17sc@Latest/device_menu.standard_tasks.label: Cell Cleaning
cl17sc@Latest/device_menu.standard_tasks.description: Stops measurements and prompts the user to manually clean the colorimetric cell with sulfuric acid solution and cotton swabs; outputs can be held at last value or transferred during the task.

cl17sc@Latest/device_menu.standard_tasks.label: Replace Reagents
cl17sc@Latest/device_menu.standard_tasks.description: Stops measurements and guides the user through replacing the buffer and indicator reagent bottles; outputs can be held at last value or transferred during the task.
