CONFID LEVEL: Sets the percentage rate at which chlorine OR pH measurements must be out of range before an alarm occurs and must be in range before auto-cancellation — 50 to 95% (default).

cl10sc@unknown/sensor_setup.configure.se.label: LCC
cl10sc@unknown/sensor_setup.configure.se.description: ACTIVATE TMR: Sets the time a chlorine measurement can be 0.5 ppm or higher before an alarm occurs (only if the previous calibration used a low chlorine concentration process flow) — 10 to 999 minutes (default 30 min). CONFID LEVEL: Sets the percentage rate at which chlorine measurements must be ≥0.5 ppm before an alarm occurs and must be <0.5 ppm before auto-cancellation — 50 to 95% (default).

cl10sc@unknown/sensor_setup.configure.se.label: Deactivate Timer
cl10sc@unknown/sensor_setup.configure.se.description: Sets the amount of time an alarm is on before it is automatically canceled if measurements return to range.

cl10sc@unknown/sensor_setup.configure.se.label: All
cl10sc@unknown/sensor_setup.configure.se.description: Sets the time a chlorine AND pH deviation alarm is on before it is canceled — 10 to 99 minutes (default 30 min).

cl10sc@unknown/sensor_setup.configure.se.label: CL2/pH Only
cl10sc@unknown/sensor_setup.configure.se.description: Sets the time a chlorine OR pH deviation alarm is on before it is canceled — 10 to 999 minutes (default 30 min).

cl10sc@unknown/sensor_setup.configure.se.label: LCC
cl10sc@unknown/sensor_setup.configure.se.description: Sets the time an LCC alarm is on before it is canceled — 10 to 999 minutes (default 30 min).

cl10sc@unknown/sensor_setup.configure.se.label: CL2 Deviation
cl10sc@unknown/sensor_setup.configure.se.description: Sets the chlorine measurement deviation values that activate alarms.

cl10sc@unknown/sensor_setup.configure.se.label: CL2 Error Deviation
cl10sc@unknown/sensor_setup.configure.se.description: Sets the chlorine measurement deviation that activates an error alarm — 30 to 99% (default 50%).

cl10sc@unknown/sensor_setup.configure.se.label: CL2 Warning Deviation
cl10sc@unknown/sensor_setup.configure.se.description: Sets the chlorine measurement deviation that activates a warning alarm — 10 to 30% (default 20%).

cl10sc@unknown/sensor_setup.configure.se.label: pH Deviation
cl10sc@unknown/sensor_setup.configure.se.description: Sets the pH measurement deviation values that activate alarms.

cl10sc@unknown/sensor_setup.configure.se.label: pH Error Deviation
cl10sc@unknown/sensor_setup.configure.se.description: Sets the pH measurement deviation that activates an error alarm — 1 (default) to 3 pH units.

cl10sc@unknown/sensor_setup.configure.se.label: pH Warning Deviation
cl10sc@unknown/sensor_setup.configure.se.description: Sets the pH measurement deviation that activates a warning alarm — 0.5 (default) to 1 pH unit.

cl10sc@unknown/sensor_setup.configure.se.label: Filter
cl10sc@unknown/sensor_setup.configure.se.description: Sets a time constant to increase signal stability; calculates the average value during a specified time — 0 (filtering disabled) to 60 seconds.

cl10sc@unknown/sensor_setup.configure.se.label: Log Setup
cl10sc@unknown/sensor_setup.configure.se.description: Sets the time interval for event and data logging for chlorine concentration and flow status — 10 s, 30 s, 1 min, 5 min, 15 min (default), or 60 min.

cl10sc@unknown/sensor_setup.configure.re.label: Reset Defaults
cl10sc@unknown/sensor_setup.configure.re.description: Sets the configuration menu to the default settings; all sensor information is lost.

cl10sc@unknown/sensor_setup.calibrate.ch.label: 1 Point Sample
cl10sc@unknown/sensor_setup.calibrate.ch.description: Performs a 1-point calibration using either a zero calibration or a process concentration measurement.

cl10sc@unknown/sensor_setup.calibrate.ch.label: Output Signal Mode
cl10sc@unknown/sensor_setup.calibrate.ch.description: Sets the output signal behavior during calibration — Active, Hold, or Transfer.

cl10sc@unknown/sensor_setup.calibrate.ch.label: Electrical
cl10sc@unknown/sensor_setup.calibrate.ch.description: Removes the offset produced by the gateway to set the zero-point electronically (no sample used).

cl10sc@unknown/sensor_setup.calibrate.ch.label: Chemical
cl10sc@unknown/sensor_setup.calibrate.ch.description: Measures water with no chlorine to set the zero-point chemically.

cl10sc@unknown/sensor_setup.calibrate.ch.label: Process Conc
cl10sc@unknown/sensor_setup.calibrate.ch.description: Measures the chlorine concentration of the process flow (grab sample analysis) and enters the measured value to set the calibration slope.

cl10sc@unknown/sensor_setup.calibrate.ch.label: 2 Point Sample
cl10sc@unknown/sensor_setup.calibrate.ch.description: Performs a 2-point calibration using a zero calibration and a process concentration measurement.

cl10sc@unknown/sensor_setup.calibrate.ch.label: Output Signal Mode
cl10sc@unknown/sensor_setup.calibrate.ch.description: Sets the output signal behavior during calibration — Active, Hold, or Transfer.

cl10sc@unknown/sensor_setup.calibrate.ch.label: Calibration Type
cl10sc@unknown/sensor_setup.calibrate.ch.description: Select the zero-point method — Electrical or Chemical.

cl10sc@unknown/sensor_setup.calibrate.ch.label: Electrical
cl10sc@unknown/sensor_setup.calibrate.ch.description: Removes the offset produced by the gateway for the zero-point, then measures the process sample to calculate slope.

cl10sc@unknown/sensor_setup.calibrate.ch.label: Chemical
cl10sc@unknown/sensor_setup.calibrate.ch.description: Measures water with no chlorine for the zero-point, then measures the process sample to calculate slope.

cl10sc@unknown/sensor_setup.calibrate.ch.label: Reset Defaults
cl10sc@unknown/sensor_setup.calibrate.ch.description: Replaces the user calibration settings with the default calibration settings.

cl10sc@unknown/sensor_setup.calibrate.ch.label: Cal Options
cl10sc@unknown/sensor_setup.calibrate.ch.description: Sets calibration reminder, auto stabilization, and operator ID options.

cl10sc@unknown/sensor_setup.calibrate.ch.label: Auto Stab
cl10sc@unknown/sensor_setup.calibrate.ch.description: Enables automatic acceptance of the measurement signal when stable, advancing the calibration automatically — On or Off (default); stabilization range 25 to 75 ppb.

cl10sc@unknown/sensor_setup.calibrate.ch.label: Cal Reminder
cl10sc@unknown/sensor_setup.calibrate.ch.description: Sets a reminder for the next calibration in days, months, or years.

cl10sc@unknown/sensor_setup.calibrate.ch.label: Operator ID on Cal
cl10sc@unknown/sensor_setup.calibrate.ch.description: Includes an operator ID with calibration data — Yes or No (default); the ID is entered during calibration.

cl10sc@unknown/sensor_setup.diag_test.label: Diag/Test
cl10sc@unknown/sensor_setup.diag_test.description: The diagnostic and test menu shows current and historical information about the chlorine analyzer.

cl10sc@unknown/sensor_setup.diag_test.ga.label: Gateway Info
cl10sc@unknown/sensor_setup.diag_test.ga.description: Shows the firmware version, driver version, serial number, and boot version for the controller and the types of sensors connected.

cl10sc@unknown/sensor_setup.diag_test.ca.label: Cal Days
cl10sc@unknown/sensor_setup.diag_test.ca.description: Shows the number of days since the sensor was last calibrated.

cl10sc@unknown/sensor_setup.diag_test.ca.label: Cal History
cl10sc@unknown/sensor_setup.diag_test.ca.description: Shows a list of the times when the sensor was calibrated; push ENTER to scroll through entries and view a summary of calibration data.

cl10sc@unknown/sensor_setup.diag_test.rs.label: Reset Cal History
cl10sc@unknown/sensor_setup.diag_test.rs.description: Resets the sensor calibration history; requires passcode.

cl10sc@unknown/sensor_setup.diag_test.si.label: Signals
cl10sc@unknown/sensor_setup.diag_test.si.description: Shows the sensor measurement signal value in mV.

cl10sc@unknown/sensor_setup.diag_test.se.label: Sensor Days
cl10sc@unknown/sensor_setup.diag_test.se.description: Shows the number of days the sensor has been in operation.

cl10sc@unknown/sensor_setup.diag_test.rs.label: Reset Sensors
cl10sc@unknown/sensor_setup.diag_test.rs.description: Resets the sensor days and calibration days to default; requires passcode.

cl10sc@unknown/sensor_setup.diag_test.ca.label: Calibration
cl10sc@unknown/sensor_setup.diag_test.ca.description: Shows the slope and offset values for chlorine and pH (if pH sensor is used), and the temperature offset (if pH sensor is used).

ldo_sc_model2@1.29/device_menu.settings.label: Settings
ldo_sc_model2@1.29/device_menu.settings.description: Configure the sensor for measurements, cleaning reminders, data handling and storage.

ldo_sc_model2@1.29/device_menu.settings..label: Name
ldo_sc_model2@1.29/device_menu.settings..description: Changes the name that corresponds to the sensor on the measurement screen; limited to 16 characters.

ldo_sc_model2@1.29/device_menu.settings..label: Unit
ldo_sc_model2@1.29/device_menu.settings..description: Sets the units for temperature, measurement, and altitude/pressure.

ldo_sc_model2@1.29/device_menu.settings..label: Temperature
ldo_sc_model2@1.29/device_menu.settings..description: Sets the temperature units to °C (default) or °F.

ldo_sc_model2@1.29/device_menu.settings..label: Measurement
ldo_sc_model2@1.29/device_menu.settings..description: Sets the measurement units to mg/L, ppm (default) or %.

ldo_sc_model2@1.29/device_menu.settings..label: Altitude/Pressure
ldo_sc_model2@1.29/device_menu.settings..description: Sets the units for atmospheric pressure display to altitude (m or ft) or pressure (mmHg or torr).

ldo_sc_model2@1.29/device_menu.settings..label: Salinity
ldo_sc_model2@1.29/device_menu.settings..description: Sets the salinity correction value from 0.00 (default) to 250.00 parts per thousand (‰).

ldo_sc_model2@1.29/device_menu.settings..label: Signal Average
ldo_sc_model2@1.29/device_menu.settings..description: Sets a time constant (0–999 seconds, default 60 s) to calculate a rolling average and increase signal stability.

ldo_sc_model2@1.29/device_menu.settings..label: Cleaning Interval
ldo_sc_model2@1.29/device_menu.settings..description: Sets the interval in days for the cleaning reminder (default: 0 days); set to 0 to disable.

ldo_sc_model2@1.29/device_menu.settings..label: Reset Cleaning Interval
ldo_sc_model2@1.29/device_menu.settings..description: Resets the Days Remaining to Clean counter back to the Cleaning Interval value.

ldo_sc_model2@1.29/device_menu.settings..label: Data Logger Interval
ldo_sc_model2@1.29/device_menu.settings..description: Sets the time interval for data storage in the data log (30 s, 1, 2, 5, 10, 15 [default], 30, or 60 minutes).

ldo_sc_model2@1.29/device_menu.settings..label: Reset
ldo_sc_model2@1.29/device_menu.settings..description: Resets all sensor settings back to factory defaults; does not change calibration slope or offset.

ldo_sc_model2@1.29/device_menu.calibrati.label: Calibration
ldo_sc_model2@1.29/device_menu.calibrati.description: Calibration options for the LDO sc Model 2 sensor.

ldo_sc_model2@1.29/device_menu.calibrati.label: Air Calibration
ldo_sc_model2@1.29/device_menu.calibrati.description: Recommended one-point calibration method using water-saturated air that modifies the calibration slope.

ldo_sc_model2@1.29/device_menu.calibrati.label: Calibration
ldo_sc_model2@1.29/device_menu.calibrati.description: Calibration by comparison with a hand-held DO meter that modifies the calibration offset.

ldo_sc_model2@1.29/device_menu.calibrati.label: Reset Calibration
ldo_sc_model2@1.29/device_menu.calibrati.description: Resets the calibration gain (slope) and offset to factory defaults (gain = 1.0, offset = 0.0).

ldo_sc_model2@1.29/device_menu.diagnosti.label: Diagnostics
ldo_sc_model2@1.29/device_menu.diagnosti.description: Sensor diagnostic and test information for troubleshooting.

ldo_sc_model2@1.29/device_menu.diagnosti.label: Sensor Information
ldo_sc_model2@1.29/device_menu.diagnosti.description: Shows the software version and driver version installed on the sensor.

ldo_sc_model2@1.29/device_menu.diagnosti.label: Serial Number
ldo_sc_model2@1.29/device_menu.diagnosti.description: Shows the serial number of the sensor.

ldo_sc_model2@1.29/device_menu.diagnosti.label: Gain Correction
ldo_sc_model2@1.29/device_menu.diagnosti.description: Adjusts the calibration gain (slope) value within the range 0.50 to 1.5.

ldo_sc_model2@1.29/device_menu.diagnosti.label: Offset Correction
ldo_sc_model2@1.29/device_menu.diagnosti.description: Adjusts the calibration offset value within the range –3.00 to +3.00.

ldo_sc_model2@1.29/device_menu.diagnosti.label: Phase Diagnostics
ldo_sc_model2@1.29/device_menu.diagnosti.description: Shows the phase for total, red and blue wavelengths; updates once per second.

ldo_sc_model2@1.29/device_menu.diagnosti.label: Amplitude Diagnostics
ldo_sc_model2@1.29/device_menu.diagnosti.description: Shows the amplitude for red and blue wavelengths; updates once per second.

ldo_sc_model2@1.29/device_menu.diagnosti.label: Days Remaining to Clean
ldo_sc_model2@1.29/device_menu.diagnosti.description: Shows the number of days until the next scheduled manual cleaning.

ldo_sc_model2@1.29/device_menu.diagnosti.label: Sensor Life
ldo_sc_model2@1.29/device_menu.diagnosti.description: Shows the number of days until the next scheduled sensor cap replacement.

nt3100sc@unknown/device_menu.configurati.label: Edit Name
nt3100sc@unknown/device_menu.configurati.description: Enters a description for the measurement site (default: serial number); used to identify measurement locations (e.g., Aeration tank 1), and saved with measurement values in the controller data log.

nt3100sc@unknown/device_menu.configurati.label: Parameter
nt3100sc@unknown/device_menu.configurati.description: Selects the measured parameter: NOX-N (default), NOX, NO3-N or NO3.

nt3100sc@unknown/device_menu.configurati.label: Unit
nt3100sc@unknown/device_menu.configurati.description: Sets the measurement units: mg/L (default) or ppm.

nt3100sc@unknown/device_menu.configurati.label: Measurement Interval
nt3100sc@unknown/device_menu.configurati.description: Sets the measurement interval: 15 s, 30 s, 1 min, 5 min (default), 10 min, 15 min or 30 min.

nt3100sc@unknown/device_menu.configurati.label: Signal Average
nt3100sc@unknown/device_menu.configurati.description: Sets the number of saved measurements used to calculate the average (1–12, default 3); the controller shows, saves and outputs this average.

nt3100sc@unknown/device_menu.configurati.label: Cleaning Interval
nt3100sc@unknown/device_menu.configurati.description: Sets the cleaning interval: once per measurement (default), 1, 5, 10 or 30 minutes, or 1, 6 or 12 hours.

nt3100sc@unknown/device_menu.configurati.label: Wiper Mode
nt3100sc@unknown/device_menu.configurati.description: Sets the wiper cleaning cycle: Single (one sweep per cycle), Double A-B-A, or Double B-A-B (default); the wiper must stop in the top position.

nt3100sc@unknown/device_menu.configurati.label: Extended Sludge Mode
nt3100sc@unknown/device_menu.configurati.description: Sets the number of additional measurements per concentration calculation: High, Medium (default), Low, None, or Auto.

nt3100sc@unknown/device_menu.configurati.label: Bypass
nt3100sc@unknown/device_menu.configurati.description: Set to No (default) or Yes; select Yes when the probe is installed in a flow-through unit (disables wiper out position).

nt3100sc@unknown/device_menu.configurati.label: Output Mode
nt3100sc@unknown/device_menu.configurati.description: Sets the output behaviour during calibration or maintenance: Hold, Active, Set Transfer, or Selection (default).

nt3100sc@unknown/device_menu.configurati.label: Service Reminder
nt3100sc@unknown/device_menu.configurati.description: Sets the interval for service reminders: off, 3, 6, 12 (default) or 24 months.

nt3100sc@unknown/device_menu.configurati.label: Reminder Interval
nt3100sc@unknown/device_menu.configurati.description: Sets the interval for maintenance reminders: 1 day, 3 days, 1 week (default), 2, 3 or 4 weeks.

nt3100sc@unknown/device_menu.configurati.label: Reset Configuration to Defaults
nt3100sc@unknown/device_menu.configurati.description: Resets all configuration settings back to factory defaults.

nt3100sc@unknown/device_menu.calibration.label: Offset Calibration
nt3100sc@unknown/device_menu.calibration.description: Calibrates the probe by calculating and entering an offset (and optionally a factor) derived from a comparison of probe readings to laboratory measurements; this is the recommended calibration method.

nt3100sc@unknown/device_menu.calibration.label: Offset
nt3100sc@unknown/device_menu.calibration.description: Lowers or raises the calibration curve; valid range depends on path length (±9 mg/L for 1 mm, ±5 mg/L for 2 mm, ±2.5 mg/L for 5 mm NOx-N).

nt3100sc@unknown/device_menu.calibration.label: Factor
nt3100sc@unknown/device_menu.calibration.description: Adjusts the slope of the calibration curve; calculated as (High lab value – Low lab value) ÷ (High probe reading – Low probe reading).

nt3100sc@unknown/device_menu.calibration.label: Standard Calibration
nt3100sc@unknown/device_menu.calibration.description: Performs a 1-point calibration with a known standard to verify and adjust the calibration factor (does not change the offset); not recommended as primary calibration method.

nt3100sc@unknown/device_menu.calibration.label: Standard Value
nt3100sc@unknown/device_menu.calibration.description: Selects the concentration of the calibration standard (or known sample) used for the standard calibration.

nt3100sc@unknown/device_menu.calibration.label: Calibration Interval
nt3100sc@unknown/device_menu.calibration.description: Sets the calibration reminder interval: off (default), 1 week, 4 weeks, 3 months or 6 months.

nt3100sc@unknown/device_menu.maintenance.label: Wiper Test
nt3100sc@unknown/device_menu.maintenance.description: Triggers a wiper movement cycle for testing and for removing the wiper blade during cleaning procedures.

nt3100sc@unknown/device_menu.maintenance.label: Wiper Replacement
nt3100sc@unknown/device_menu.maintenance.description: Guides the user through the wiper blade replacement procedure with on-screen instructions.

nt3100sc@unknown/device_menu.maintenance.label: Wipe 10 Times
nt3100sc@unknown/device_menu.maintenance.description: Runs 10 consecutive wiper movements; used during the measuring-path cleaning procedure with hydrochloric acid.

nt3100sc@unknown/device_menu.diagnostics.label: Single Measurement
nt3100sc@unknown/device_menu.diagnostics.description: Performs and displays one measurement reading; used during cleaning validation and calibration checks.

nt3100sc@unknown/device_menu.diagnostics.label: 12x Average Measurement
nt3100sc@unknown/device_menu.diagnostics.description: Calculates and displays the average of twelve consecutive measurements; used for offset calibration and probe validation.

phd_sc@Any/device_menu.configure.label: Configure
phd_sc@Any/device_menu.configure.description: Select a sensor name and type of sensor; change options for measurement, calibration, data handling and storage.

phd_sc@Any/device_menu.configure.name.label: Name
phd_sc@Any/device_menu.configure.name.description: Changes the name displayed at the top of the measurement screen; limited to 12 characters (letters, numbers, spaces or punctuation).

phd_sc@Any/device_menu.configure.select_.label: Select sensor
phd_sc@Any/device_menu.configure.select_.description: Selects the type of sensor (pH or ORP).

phd_sc@Any/device_menu.configure.format.label: Format
phd_sc@Any/device_menu.configure.format.description: For pH sensors only—changes the number of decimal places shown on the measurement screen to XX.XX (default) or XX.X.

phd_sc@Any/device_menu.configure.tempera.label: Temperature
phd_sc@Any/device_menu.configure.tempera.description: Sets the temperature units to °C (default) or °F.

phd_sc@Any/device_menu.configure.data_lo.label: Data logger interval
phd_sc@Any/device_menu.configure.data_lo.description: Sets the time interval for data storage in the data log—Disabled, 5, 10, 15, 30 seconds, 1, 5, 10, 15 (default), 30 minutes, 1, 2, 6, 12 hours.

phd_sc@Any/device_menu.configure.ac_freq.label: Alternating current frequency
phd_sc@Any/device_menu.configure.ac_freq.description: Selects the frequency of the AC power supplied to the controller (50 or 60 Hz).

phd_sc@Any/device_menu.configure.filter.label: Filter
phd_sc@Any/device_menu.configure.filter.description: Sets a time constant (0 to 60 seconds) to calculate an average value and increase signal stability; 0 = no effect (default).

phd_sc@Any/device_menu.configure.tempera.label: Temperature element
phd_sc@Any/device_menu.configure.tempera.description: pH sensors—sets the temperature element for automatic temperature compensation to PT100, PT1000, NTC300 (default) or Manual; ORP sensors—a temperature element can be connected to measure temperature only.

phd_sc@Any/device_menu.configure.select_.label: Select standard buffer
phd_sc@Any/device_menu.configure.select_.description: For pH sensors only—selects the buffer solutions used for calibration: pH 4, 7, 10 (default) or DIN 19267.

phd_sc@Any/device_menu.configure.pure_h2.label: Pure H2O compensation
phd_sc@Any/device_menu.configure.pure_h2.description: For pH sensors only—adds a temperature-dependent correction for pure water with additives: None (default), Ammonia, Morpholine, Pure water, User defined, or 1–4-point matrix correction.

phd_sc@Any/device_menu.configure.last_ca.label: Last calibration
phd_sc@Any/device_menu.configure.last_ca.description: Sets a reminder interval (default: 60 days) for the next calibration; a reminder appears on the display after the selected number of days from the last calibration date.

phd_sc@Any/device_menu.configure.sensor_.label: Sensor days
phd_sc@Any/device_menu.configure.sensor_.description: Sets the sensor replacement interval (default: 365 days); a warning appears when the sensor has been in operation longer than this interval.

phd_sc@Any/device_menu.configure.impedan.label: Impedance limits
phd_sc@Any/device_menu.configure.impedan.description: Sets the low (default: 0 MΩ) and high (default: 1000 MΩ) impedance limits for the active and reference electrodes.

phd_sc@Any/device_menu.configure.reset_s.label: Reset setup
phd_sc@Any/device_menu.configure.reset_s.description: Sets all sensor settings back to factory defaults and resets counters; all device information is lost.

phd_sc@Any/device_menu.calibrate.ph_cali.label: 1-point auto correction
phd_sc@Any/device_menu.calibrate.ph_cali.description: Uses one buffer (e.g., pH 7); the sensor automatically identifies the buffer during calibration.

phd_sc@Any/device_menu.calibrate.ph_cali.label: 2-point auto correction
phd_sc@Any/device_menu.calibrate.ph_cali.description: Uses two buffers (e.g., pH 7 and pH 4); the sensor automatically identifies the buffers during calibration (recommended).

phd_sc@Any/device_menu.calibrate.ph_cali.label: 1-point manual correction
phd_sc@Any/device_menu.calibrate.ph_cali.description: Uses a sample of known pH value or one buffer; the user enters the pH value during calibration.

phd_sc@Any/device_menu.calibrate.ph_cali.label: 2-point manual correction
phd_sc@Any/device_menu.calibrate.ph_cali.description: Uses two samples of known pH value or two buffers; the user enters the pH values during calibration.

phd_sc@Any/device_menu.calibrate.orp_cal.label: 1-point manual correction
phd_sc@Any/device_menu.calibrate.orp_cal.description: Calibrates the ORP sensor against one reference solution or sample of known value; the user enters the ORP value during calibration.

phd_sc@Any/device_menu.calibrate.tempera.label: Temperature adjustment
phd_sc@Any/device_menu.calibrate.tempera.description: Calibrates the temperature reading against an accurate external thermometer by entering the exact measured temperature value.

phd_sc@Any/device_menu.calibrate.exit_ca.label: Cancel
phd_sc@Any/device_menu.calibrate.exit_ca.description: Stops the calibration; a new calibration must start from the beginning.

phd_sc@Any/device_menu.calibrate.exit_ca.label: Exit
phd_sc@Any/device_menu.calibrate.exit_ca.description: Exits the calibration temporarily; access to other menus is allowed and a calibration for a second sensor (if present) can be started.

phd_sc@Any/device_menu.calibrate.factory.label: Reset setup
phd_sc@Any/device_menu.calibrate.factory.description: Sets the sensor back to the factory calibration values.

phd_sc@Any/device_menu.diagnostics.label: Diagnostics
phd_sc@Any/device_menu.diagnostics.description: Access sensor diagnostic information and test readings.

phd_sc@Any/device_menu.diagnostics.senso.label: Sensor information
phd_sc@Any/device_menu.diagnostics.senso.description: Shows the sensor type, name, serial number, software version and driver version.

phd_sc@Any/device_menu.diagnostics.calib.label: Calibration history
phd_sc@Any/device_menu.diagnostics.calib.description: Shows the pH slope (mV/pH) and date of the last calibration; the pH slope should be 55 to 61 mV/pH.

phd_sc@Any/device_menu.diagnostics.signa.label: Sensor signal
phd_sc@Any/device_menu.diagnostics.signa.description: Shows the sensor reading in mV; the mV range is –60 to +60 mV (0 mV = pH 7).

phd_sc@Any/device_menu.diagnostics.signa.label: Measurement analog to digital converter counter
phd_sc@Any/device_menu.diagnostics.signa.description: Shows the digital number that represents the pH or ORP reading.

phd_sc@Any/device_menu.diagnostics.signa.label: Temperature analog to digital converter counter
phd_sc@Any/device_menu.diagnostics.signa.description: Shows the digital number that represents the temperature reading.

phd_sc@Any/device_menu.diagnostics.signa.label: Impedance status
phd_sc@Any/device_menu.diagnostics.signa.description: When set to Enabled (recommended), measures active and reference electrode impedance at 1-minute intervals and shows an error when impedance is outside the configured limits.

phd_sc@Any/device_menu.diagnostics.count.label: Sensor days
phd_sc@Any/device_menu.diagnostics.count.description: Shows the number of days the sensor has been in operation.

phd_sc@Any/device_menu.diagnostics.count.label: Reset
phd_sc@Any/device_menu.diagnostics.count.description: Sets the Sensor days and Electrode days values to zero.

phd_sc@Any/device_menu.diagnostics.count.label: Electrode days
phd_sc@Any/device_menu.diagnostics.count.description: Shows the number of days since the salt bridge was replaced; automatically reset to zero when the salt bridge is replaced.

solitax_sc@All/sensor_setup.label: Sensor Setup
solitax_sc@All/sensor_setup.description: Configure and operate the SOLITAX sc sensor via the sc controller.

solitax_sc@All/sensor_setup.configure.label: Configure
solitax_sc@All/sensor_setup.configure.description: Select measurement parameter, units, intervals and defaults for the sensor.

solitax_sc@All/sensor_setup.configure.ed.label: Edit Name
solitax_sc@All/sensor_setup.configure.ed.description: Enter up to a 10-character sensor name using any combination of symbols and alphanumeric characters; default is the sensor serial number.

solitax_sc@All/sensor_setup.configure.se.label: Set Parameter
solitax_sc@All/sensor_setup.configure.se.description: Configures the sensor to measure turbidity (TRB) or suspended solids (TS); the sensor cannot measure both simultaneously.

solitax_sc@All/sensor_setup.configure.me.label: Meas Units
solitax_sc@All/sensor_setup.configure.me.description: Selects the measurement units: TRB — FNU (default), EBC, TE/F, NTU; TS — mg/L, g/L, ppm, %.

solitax_sc@All/sensor_setup.configure.cl.label: Clean Interval
solitax_sc@All/sensor_setup.configure.cl.description: Sets the interval between automated wiper cleaning cycles — 1, 5, 15, or 30 minutes; 1, 4, or 12 hours; 1, 3, or 7 days (default: 12 hours).

solitax_sc@All/sensor_setup.configure.re.label: Response Time
solitax_sc@All/sensor_setup.configure.re.description: Sets the damping/averaging period for displayed readings, 4–20 outputs, and alarm updates — 0 to 300 seconds (default: 3 seconds).

solitax_sc@All/sensor_setup.configure.lo.label: Logger Interval
solitax_sc@All/sensor_setup.configure.lo.description: Sets the data log storage interval — 1 to 15 minutes (default: 10 minutes); logged values are the average of all readings during the previous interval.

solitax_sc@All/sensor_setup.configure.se.label: Set Defaults
solitax_sc@All/sensor_setup.configure.se.description: Resets all user-editable options to factory default settings.

solitax_sc@All/sensor_setup.calibrate.se.label: Set Outmode
solitax_sc@All/sensor_setup.calibrate.se.description: Selects the behavior of the 4–20 mA outputs and alarm relays during calibration — Active, Hold, or Transfer.

solitax_sc@All/sensor_setup.calibrate.se.label: Sensor Measure
solitax_sc@All/sensor_setup.calibrate.se.description: Displays the current, uncorrected measured value from the sensor.

solitax_sc@All/sensor_setup.calibrate.of.label: Offset
solitax_sc@All/sensor_setup.calibrate.of.description: Sets the turbidity zero-point offset value, calculated from a deionized water reading during turbidity calibration.

solitax_sc@All/sensor_setup.calibrate.fa.label: Factor
solitax_sc@All/sensor_setup.calibrate.fa.description: Enters the single-point calibration factor for turbidity or suspended solids, calculated from a known standard or gravimetric reference value.

solitax_sc@All/sensor_setup.calibrate.ca.label: Factor
solitax_sc@All/sensor_setup.calibrate.ca.description: Single-point calibration; calculates a new factor from one grab sample and the sensor reading at that moment.

solitax_sc@All/sensor_setup.calibrate.ca.label: 2 Points
solitax_sc@All/sensor_setup.calibrate.ca.description: Two-point suspended solids calibration; enter pairs of sensor readings and laboratory-determined values in ascending order.

solitax_sc@All/sensor_setup.calibrate.ca.label: 3 Points
solitax_sc@All/sensor_setup.calibrate.ca.description: Three-point suspended solids calibration; enter pairs of sensor readings and laboratory-determined values in ascending order.

solitax_sc@All/sensor_setup.calibrate.ca.label: 4 Points
solitax_sc@All/sensor_setup.calibrate.ca.description: Four-point suspended solids calibration; enter pairs of sensor readings and laboratory-determined values in ascending order.

solitax_sc@All/sensor_setup.calibrate.ca.label: 5 Points
solitax_sc@All/sensor_setup.calibrate.ca.description: Five-point suspended solids calibration; enter pairs of sensor readings and laboratory-determined values in ascending order.

solitax_sc@All/sensor_setup.calibrate.ca.label: Set Cal Default
solitax_sc@All/sensor_setup.calibrate.ca.description: Returns the sensor to factory default calibration settings.

solitax_sc@All/sensor_setup.test_maint.label: Test/Maint
solitax_sc@All/sensor_setup.test_maint.description: Access diagnostic information and maintenance functions for the sensor.

solitax_sc@All/sensor_setup.test_maint.w.label: Wipe
solitax_sc@All/sensor_setup.test_maint.w.description: Initiates an immediate wiping action on the sensor optical window.

solitax_sc@All/sensor_setup.test_maint.s.label: Signals
solitax_sc@All/sensor_setup.test_maint.s.description: Displays the current signal outputs for the sensor.

solitax_sc@All/sensor_setup.test_maint.o.label: Output Mode
solitax_sc@All/sensor_setup.test_maint.o.description: Selects the behavior of the instrument outputs during test/maintenance — Hold, Active, Transfer, or Selection.

solitax_sc@All/sensor_setup.test_maint.d.label: Default Setup
solitax_sc@All/sensor_setup.test_maint.d.description: Resets all user-editable options to factory defaults.

solitax_sc@All/sensor_setup.test_maint.p.label: Probe Info
solitax_sc@All/sensor_setup.test_maint.p.description: Displays the sensor type, sensor name, serial number, software version number, and sensor driver version number.

solitax_sc@All/sensor_setup.test_maint.p.label: Profile Counter
solitax_sc@All/sensor_setup.test_maint.p.description: Displays the number of wiper cycles remaining (counts down from 20,000).

solitax_sc@All/sensor_setup.test_maint.p.label: Reset Config
solitax_sc@All/sensor_setup.test_maint.p.description: Manually resets the wiper profile counter; confirm with MAN. RESET ARE YOU SURE?

solitax_sc@All/sensor_setup.test_maint.c.label: Counter
solitax_sc@All/sensor_setup.test_maint.c.description: Shows the number of hours or cycles remaining for operating hours, test/maintenance interval, gasket, and motor.

sonatax_sc@1.16/sensor_setup.calibrate.p.label: Plunger Depth
sonatax_sc@1.16/sensor_setup.calibrate.p.description: Plunger depth of the probe underside. Configurable: 0.1 m to 3 m (0.3 ft to 9.8 ft).

sonatax_sc@1.16/sensor_setup.calibrate.r.label: Reflex List
sonatax_sc@1.16/sensor_setup.calibrate.r.description: Shows the reflex list; a new measurement can be triggered. Lists all detected solid bodies that clearly reflected the ultrasonic impulse, with measurement depth in m or ft and signal strength as a percentage relative to the strongest signal.

sonatax_sc@1.16/sensor_setup.calibrate.t.label: Tank Depth
sonatax_sc@1.16/sensor_setup.calibrate.t.description: Entry of the floor depth. Configurable: 1.00 m to 12 m (3.3 ft to 39.4 ft).

sonatax_sc@1.16/sensor_setup.calibrate.p.label: Profile List
sonatax_sc@1.16/sensor_setup.calibrate.p.description: A profile calculated from the ultrasound echo, shown as profile strength at corresponding depths. A new measurement can be triggered.

sonatax_sc@1.16/sensor_setup.calibrate.a.label: Factor
sonatax_sc@1.16/sensor_setup.calibrate.a.description: Correction factor for the speed of sound. Configurable: 0.3 to 3.0, default 1.0. Change only if the local speed of sound in the fluid deviates from water.

sonatax_sc@1.16/sensor_setup.calibrate.a.label: Threshold Auto
sonatax_sc@1.16/sensor_setup.calibrate.a.description: Automatic threshold that constantly adapts to environmental conditions and adjusts sensitivity for maximum accuracy. Recommendation: 75%. Configurable: 1–95%.

sonatax_sc@1.16/sensor_setup.calibrate.a.label: LL Thresh. Auto
sonatax_sc@1.16/sensor_setup.calibrate.a.description: Gives the smallest possible value that the threshold can accept. Configurable: 0.1 to 1.0, recommendation 0.3.

sonatax_sc@1.16/sensor_setup.calibrate.a.label: Fade-Out
sonatax_sc@1.16/sensor_setup.calibrate.a.description: Fades out a defined depth range so fixed installations or other influences at those depths are completely ignored. Configurable: ON, OFF.

sonatax_sc@1.16/sensor_setup.calibrate.a.label: Begin
sonatax_sc@1.16/sensor_setup.calibrate.a.description: Upper limit of the range to be faded out. Only active when FADE-OUT = ON.

sonatax_sc@1.16/sensor_setup.calibrate.a.label: End
sonatax_sc@1.16/sensor_setup.calibrate.a.description: Lower limit of the range to be faded out. Only active when FADE-OUT = ON.

sonatax_sc@1.16/sensor_setup.calibrate.a.label: Set Defaults
sonatax_sc@1.16/sensor_setup.calibrate.a.description: Resets all advanced settings to factory configuration after a security prompt.

sonatax_sc@1.16/sensor_setup.configure.e.label: Edit Name
sonatax_sc@1.16/sensor_setup.configure.e.description: Freely editable sensor name, up to 16 characters. Factory setting: device number.

sonatax_sc@1.16/sensor_setup.configure.p.label: Parameter
sonatax_sc@1.16/sensor_setup.configure.p.description: Selects whether the measurement result is shown as sludge level (distance from water surface) or sludge height (distance from tank floor). Configurable: sludge level, sludge height.

sonatax_sc@1.16/sensor_setup.configure.m.label: Meas Units
sonatax_sc@1.16/sensor_setup.configure.m.description: Dimension of the measurement result. Configurable: meters, feet.

sonatax_sc@1.16/sensor_setup.configure.c.label: Clean. Interval
sonatax_sc@1.16/sensor_setup.configure.c.description: Wipe interval. Recommendation: 15 minutes. Configurable: 1 minute to 1 hour.

sonatax_sc@1.16/sensor_setup.configure.r.label: Response Time
sonatax_sc@1.16/sensor_setup.configure.r.description: Damping of the measurement value. For high fluctuations, a high damping (e.g. 300 s) is recommended. Configurable: 10 to 1800 seconds.

sonatax_sc@1.16/sensor_setup.configure.l.label: Logger Interval
sonatax_sc@1.16/sensor_setup.configure.l.description: Interval for the internal data log. Configurable: 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 10, 15, 30 minutes.

sonatax_sc@1.16/sensor_setup.configure.s.label: Set Defaults
sonatax_sc@1.16/sensor_setup.configure.s.description: Resets all Configure menu items to factory configuration after a security prompt.

sonatax_sc@1.16/sensor_setup.test_maint..label: Sensor Name
sonatax_sc@1.16/sensor_setup.test_maint..description: Display of the device name.

sonatax_sc@1.16/sensor_setup.test_maint..label: Edit Name
sonatax_sc@1.16/sensor_setup.test_maint..description: Display of the freely selectable measurement location (factory setting: device number).

sonatax_sc@1.16/sensor_setup.test_maint..label: Serial Number
sonatax_sc@1.16/sensor_setup.test_maint..description: Device number.

sonatax_sc@1.16/sensor_setup.test_maint..label: Model Number
sonatax_sc@1.16/sensor_setup.test_maint..description: Item number of the sensor.

sonatax_sc@1.16/sensor_setup.test_maint..label: Hardware-Vers
sonatax_sc@1.16/sensor_setup.test_maint..description: Production status of the main circuit board.

sonatax_sc@1.16/sensor_setup.test_maint..label: Software-Vers
sonatax_sc@1.16/sensor_setup.test_maint..description: Sensor software version.

sonatax_sc@1.16/sensor_setup.test_maint..label: Wiper Counter
sonatax_sc@1.16/sensor_setup.test_maint..description: Backward counter for wiping processes of the wiper profile. After expiration a warning message is shown; reset after wiper change.

sonatax_sc@1.16/sensor_setup.test_maint..label: Total Time
sonatax_sc@1.16/sensor_setup.test_maint..description: Operating hours counter.

sonatax_sc@1.16/sensor_setup.test_maint..label: Motor
sonatax_sc@1.16/sensor_setup.test_maint..description: Forward counter for wiping processes.

sonatax_sc@1.16/sensor_setup.test_maint..label: Test / Maint
sonatax_sc@1.16/sensor_setup.test_maint..description: Date of the last performed maintenance.

sonatax_sc@1.16/sensor_setup.test_maint..label: Replace Profile
sonatax_sc@1.16/sensor_setup.test_maint..description: Moves the wiper arm to a central position for wiper profile change so the arm can be removed and installed without problems.

sonatax_sc@1.16/sensor_setup.test_maint..label: Moist
sonatax_sc@1.16/sensor_setup.test_maint..description: Indicator as to whether water is in the probe.

sonatax_sc@1.16/sensor_setup.test_maint..label: Temperature
sonatax_sc@1.16/sensor_setup.test_maint..description: Temperature of the surrounding water in °C or °F.

sonatax_sc@1.16/sensor_setup.test_maint..label: Sensor Angle
sonatax_sc@1.16/sensor_setup.test_maint..description: Deviation of the probe axis from the perpendicular in degrees.

sonatax_sc@1.16/sensor_setup.test_maint..label: Echo List
sonatax_sc@1.16/sensor_setup.test_maint..description: Shows the received echo signal in digits (AD converter units) at corresponding measurement depths; a new measurement can be started.

sonatax_sc@1.16/sensor_setup.test_maint..label: Profile List
sonatax_sc@1.16/sensor_setup.test_maint..description: Profile calculated from the ultrasound echo shown as profile strength at corresponding depths; a new measurement can be started.

sonatax_sc@1.16/sensor_setup.test_maint..label: Reflex List
sonatax_sc@1.16/sensor_setup.test_maint..description: Shows the reflex list; a new measurement can be triggered.

sonatax_sc@1.16/sensor_setup.test_maint..label: Frequency
sonatax_sc@1.16/sensor_setup.test_maint..description: The resonance frequency of the ultrasound transducer.

sonatax_sc@1.16/sensor_setup.test_maint..label: Ampl Diag
sonatax_sc@1.16/sensor_setup.test_maint..description: The resonance voltage of the ultrasound transducer.

sonatax_sc@1.16/sensor_setup.test_maint..label: Threshold
sonatax_sc@1.16/sensor_setup.test_maint..description: The threshold value used to determine the sludge level from the profile.

sonatax_sc@1.16/sensor_setup.test_maint..label: Show Ampl.
sonatax_sc@1.16/sensor_setup.test_maint..description: On activation, shows the resonance profile of the ultrasound transducer instead of the sludge profile as a graphic in the measurement window (sc1000 only). Can be switched ON and OFF.

tu5x00sc@1.43/sensor_setup.configure.label: Configure
tu5x00sc@1.43/sensor_setup.configure.description: Select the location name, signal averaging, measurement units, resolution, bubble reject, logger interval, programmable button function and more.

tu5x00sc@1.43/sensor_setup.configure.loc.label: Location
tu5x00sc@1.43/sensor_setup.configure.loc.description: Sets the name or location of the sample source shown on the measurement screen — 16 characters maximum; default is the serial number.

tu5x00sc@1.43/sensor_setup.configure.sig.label: Signal Average
tu5x00sc@1.43/sensor_setup.configure.sig.description: When enabled, the turbidity reading is an average of values measured during the selected time interval. TU5300 sc options: 30–90 seconds; TU5400 sc options: 1–90 seconds (default: 30 seconds).

tu5x00sc@1.43/sensor_setup.configure.mea.label: Measurement Units
tu5x00sc@1.43/sensor_setup.configure.mea.description: Selects the measurement units shown on the controller display and recorded to the data log. TU5300 sc options: NTU, FNU, TE/F, EBC, FTU. TU5400 sc options: NTU, mNTU, FNU, mFNU, TE/F, EBC, FTU, mFTU. Default: NTU.

tu5x00sc@1.43/sensor_setup.configure.res.label: Resolution
tu5x00sc@1.43/sensor_setup.configure.res.description: Selects the number of decimal places shown on the controller display. Options: 0.001 or 0.0001. TU5300 sc default: 0.001; TU5400 sc default: 0.0001.

tu5x00sc@1.43/sensor_setup.configure.bub.label: Bubble Reject
tu5x00sc@1.43/sensor_setup.configure.bub.description: Sets bubble reject to on (default) or off; when on, high turbidity readings caused by bubbles are not shown or saved to the data log.

tu5x00sc@1.43/sensor_setup.configure.log.label: Logger Interval
tu5x00sc@1.43/sensor_setup.configure.log.description: Sets the frequency at which the turbidity reading is saved to the data log. Options: 5 s, 30 s, 1, 2, 5, 10 (default), 15, or 30 minutes.

tu5x00sc@1.43/sensor_setup.configure.cle.label: Cleaning
tu5x00sc@1.43/sensor_setup.configure.cle.description: Configures the optional automatic cleaning module settings; only shown when CLEANING MODULE is set to ON.

tu5x00sc@1.43/sensor_setup.configure.set.label: Set Defaults
tu5x00sc@1.43/sensor_setup.configure.set.description: Sets the instrument settings to the factory defaults.

tu5x00sc@1.43/sensor_setup.configure.but.label: Button Function
tu5x00sc@1.43/sensor_setup.configure.but.description: Sets the function of the programmable button. Options: SERVICE, LINK2SC, OFF (default). When CLEANING MODULE is ON, additional options START WIPE and WIPER REPLACE are available.

tu5x00sc@1.43/sensor_setup.configure.flo.label: Flow Sensor
tu5x00sc@1.43/sensor_setup.configure.flo.description: Enables or disables the flow signal on the measurement screen and DIAG/TEST > SIGNALS screen, and enables or disables flow signal warnings and errors. Set to ON when the optional flow sensor is installed (default: OFF).

tu5x00sc@1.43/sensor_setup.configure.cle.label: Cleaning Module
tu5x00sc@1.43/sensor_setup.configure.cle.description: Enables or disables the automatic cleaning module menu options. Set to ON when the optional automatic cleaning module is installed (default: OFF).

tu5x00sc@1.43/sensor_setup.configure.aut.label: Auto-Check
tu5x00sc@1.43/sensor_setup.configure.aut.description: Sets the time interval and sensitivity of the automatic system check; only shown when the instrument has the automatic system check option.

tu5x00sc@1.43/sensor_setup.configure.aut.label: Check Interval
tu5x00sc@1.43/sensor_setup.configure.aut.description: Sets the time interval between automatic system checks. Options: OFF, 1, 2 (default), 3, 6, 12 hours, or 1 day.

tu5x00sc@1.43/sensor_setup.configure.aut.label: Sensitivity
tu5x00sc@1.43/sensor_setup.configure.aut.description: Sets the sensitivity of the automatic system check to vial condition. Options: HIGH or LOW (default).

tu5x00sc@1.43/sensor_setup.calibration.s.label: Setup
tu5x00sc@1.43/sensor_setup.calibration.s.description: Select the calibration curve, calibration interval, output behavior during calibration and more.

tu5x00sc@1.43/sensor_setup.calibration.s.label: Menu Guided
tu5x00sc@1.43/sensor_setup.calibration.s.description: Sets menu-guided calibration to SEALED VIAL, SYRINGE, or OFF (default); calibration instructions show on the display when set to SEALED VIAL or SYRINGE.

tu5x00sc@1.43/sensor_setup.calibration.s.label: Cal Curve
tu5x00sc@1.43/sensor_setup.calibration.s.description: Selects the type of standard and calibration curve (range). Options: STABLCAL 0–40 NTU (default, 1-point), STABLCAL 0–700 NTU (2-point), FORMAZIN 0–40 NTU (2-point), FORMAZIN 0–700 NTU (3-point), or CUSTOM (2- to 6-point, 0.02 to 700 NTU).

tu5x00sc@1.43/sensor_setup.calibration.s.label: Verification After Cal
tu5x00sc@1.43/sensor_setup.calibration.s.description: Sets the instrument to start a verification immediately after calibration is complete — on or off.

tu5x00sc@1.43/sensor_setup.calibration.s.label: Cal Reminder
tu5x00sc@1.43/sensor_setup.calibration.s.description: Sets the time interval between calibrations; a reminder shows when calibration is due. Options: OFF (default), 1 day, 7 days, 30 days, or 90 days.

tu5x00sc@1.43/sensor_setup.calibration.s.label: Output Mode
tu5x00sc@1.43/sensor_setup.calibration.s.description: Selects the output behavior during calibration. Options: ACTIVE, HOLD (default), or SET TRANSFER.

tu5x00sc@1.43/sensor_setup.calibration.s.label: Cal Points
tu5x00sc@1.43/sensor_setup.calibration.s.description: Sets the number of calibration points (2 to 6) when CAL CURVE is set to CUSTOM.

tu5x00sc@1.43/sensor_setup.calibration.s.label: Set Factory Cal
tu5x00sc@1.43/sensor_setup.calibration.s.description: Sets the calibration settings to the factory defaults.

tu5x00sc@1.43/sensor_setup.calibration.s.label: Start
tu5x00sc@1.43/sensor_setup.calibration.s.description: Starts the calibration procedure as configured in SETUP.

tu5x00sc@1.43/sensor_setup.calibration.c.label: Cal Log
tu5x00sc@1.43/sensor_setup.calibration.c.description: Shows the historical data for the last four calibrations.

tu5x00sc@1.43/sensor_setup.verification..label: Menu Guided
tu5x00sc@1.43/sensor_setup.verification..description: Sets menu-guided verification to SEALED VIAL, SYRINGE, or OFF (default). Select SEALED VIAL for verification with the glass verification rod.

tu5x00sc@1.43/sensor_setup.verification..label: Define Std Val
tu5x00sc@1.43/sensor_setup.verification..description: Measures the verification standard for later use during verification; results are recorded to the data log. For best results, measure the verification standard immediately after calibration.

tu5x00sc@1.43/sensor_setup.verification..label: Accept. Unit
tu5x00sc@1.43/sensor_setup.verification..description: Sets the acceptance range for verification to a percentage or NTU value. Options: % or NTU (or mNTU).

tu5x00sc@1.43/sensor_setup.verification..label: Accept. Range
tu5x00sc@1.43/sensor_setup.verification..description: Sets the maximum difference permitted between the recorded and measured verification standard values during verification. Options: 1 to 99% or 0.015 to 100.00 NTU.

tu5x00sc@1.43/sensor_setup.verification..label: Verif Reminder
tu5x00sc@1.43/sensor_setup.verification..description: Sets the time interval between calibration verifications; a reminder shows when verification is due. Options: OFF (default), 1 day, 7 days, 30 days, or 90 days.

tu5x00sc@1.43/sensor_setup.verification..label: Output Mode
tu5x00sc@1.43/sensor_setup.verification..description: Sets the output behavior during verification. Options: ACTIVE, HOLD (default), or SET TRANSFER.

tu5x00sc@1.43/sensor_setup.verification..label: Start
tu5x00sc@1.43/sensor_setup.verification..description: Starts the verification procedure as configured in SETUP.

tu5x00sc@1.43/sensor_setup.verification..label: Verif Log
tu5x00sc@1.43/sensor_setup.verification..description: Shows the historical data for the last four verifications.

tu5x00sc@1.43/sensor_setup.diag_test.sen.label: Sensor Info
tu5x00sc@1.43/sensor_setup.diag_test.sen.description: Shows the sensor name, location, serial number, type (EPA or ISO), model number, software version, and measurement device version.

tu5x00sc@1.43/sensor_setup.diag_test.sig.label: Signals
tu5x00sc@1.43/sensor_setup.diag_test.sig.description: Shows real-time values for turbidity, flow rate, humidity set point, air system humidity and temperature, vial condition (condensation and clarity), vial status (installed or not), and the lid type installed.

tu5x00sc@1.43/sensor_setup.diag_test.cou.label: Counters
tu5x00sc@1.43/sensor_setup.diag_test.cou.description: Shows total operational time, remaining wiper cycles, vial installation/replacement date, vial cleaning date, calibration date, verification date, desiccant operational time and remaining life, air pump operational time, and date factory service was done.

tu5x00sc@1.43/sensor_setup.diag_test.mai.label: Maintenance
tu5x00sc@1.43/sensor_setup.diag_test.mai.description: Starts menu-guided maintenance to replace or clean the vial, replace the wiper, or replace the desiccant cartridge.

tu5x00sc@1.43/sensor_setup.diag_test.mai.label: Vial Cleaning
tu5x00sc@1.43/sensor_setup.diag_test.mai.description: Starts the menu-guided vial cleaning process; the instrument automatically saves the cleaning date after the last screen.

tu5x00sc@1.43/sensor_setup.diag_test.mai.label: Vial Replacement
tu5x00sc@1.43/sensor_setup.diag_test.mai.description: Starts the menu-guided vial replacement process; the date the vial was replaced is automatically saved after the last screen.

tu5x00sc@1.43/sensor_setup.diag_test.mai.label: Output Mode
tu5x00sc@1.43/sensor_setup.diag_test.mai.description: Selects the output behaviour during maintenance (default: HOLD).

tu5x00sc@1.43/sensor_setup.diag_test.mai.label: Fix Water Ingress
tu5x00sc@1.43/sensor_setup.diag_test.mai.description: Starts the procedure to fix a water ingress error; requires installation of a new desiccant cartridge during the procedure.

tu5x00sc@1.43/sensor_setup.link2sc.label: Link2SC
tu5x00sc@1.43/sensor_setup.link2sc.description: Select the acceptance range permitted when process and laboratory measurements are compared with Link2SC.

tu5x00sc@1.43/sensor_setup.link2sc.accep.label: Accept. Unit
tu5x00sc@1.43/sensor_setup.link2sc.accep.description: Sets the units used to compare process and laboratory measurements. Options: %, NTU, or LAB (select LAB when the acceptance range is supplied by the laboratory instrument).

tu5x00sc@1.43/sensor_setup.link2sc.accep.label: Accept. Range
tu5x00sc@1.43/sensor_setup.link2sc.accep.description: Sets the maximum difference permitted between process and laboratory measurements. Options: 1 to 50% (default: 10%); only shown when ACCEPT. UNIT is set to % or NTU.

tu5x00sc@1.43/diagnostics.reminder.remin.label: Reminder List
tu5x00sc@1.43/diagnostics.reminder.remin.description: Displays active reminders such as DRYER RANGE (desiccant low), PERFORM CAL (calibration due), PERFORM VER (verification due), and WIPER REPLACE (wiper replacement due).

tu5x00sc@1.43/diagnostics.warning_list.w.label: Warning List
tu5x00sc@1.43/diagnostics.warning_list.w.description: Displays active warnings including CLEANING MODULE, DESICCANT OLD, DRYER EXHAUS'D, HIGH FLOW, HUM PCB SC, LASER-TEMP HIGH, LASER-TEMP SENS, LOW FLOW, NO FLOW, NOT DRYING, PUMP, SENS.DRY: FUNC, TURB TOO HIGH, WIPER REPLACE, and VIAL CLARITY.

tu5x00sc@1.43/diagnostics.error_list.err.label: Error List
tu5x00sc@1.43/diagnostics.error_list.err.description: Displays active errors including AUTOCHK. NO FUNC, CLEANING MODULE, EE RSRVD ERR, FLASH FAIL, HUMIDITY PCB, LASER TOO LOW, MEAS ELECTRONIC, PROC HEAD OPEN, TURB TOO HIGH, VIAL PRESENT, VIAL CLARITY, and WATER INGRESS.

uvas_plus_sc@Latest/sensor_setup.select_.label: SELECT SENSOR
uvas_plus_sc@Latest/sensor_setup.select_.description: Shown only when more than one sensor is connected.

uvas_plus_sc@Latest/sensor_setup.calibra.label: FACTOR

uvas_plus_sc@Latest/sensor_setup.calibra.label: OFFSET
uvas_plus_sc@Latest/sensor_setup.calibra.description: Adjustable from -250 to +250 mE for zero point correction.

uvas_plus_sc@Latest/sensor_setup.calibra.label: ZERO CAL
uvas_plus_sc@Latest/sensor_setup.calibra.description: Initiates zero point calibration using distilled water; see zero point calibration procedure.

uvas_plus_sc@Latest/sensor_setup.calibra.label: 1 SAMPLE CAL
uvas_plus_sc@Latest/sensor_setup.calibra.description: Initiates 1-point calibration using a reference sample; see 1 point calibration procedure.

uvas_plus_sc@Latest/sensor_setup.calibra.label: VERIFY
uvas_plus_sc@Latest/sensor_setup.calibra.description: Initiates verification using a test glass filter; see verifying procedure.

uvas_plus_sc@Latest/sensor_setup.calibra.label: OUTPUT MODE
uvas_plus_sc@Latest/sensor_setup.calibra.description: Defines the behaviour of the outputs during calibration or zero point setting.

uvas_plus_sc@Latest/sensor_setup.calibra.label: CAL INTERVAL
uvas_plus_sc@Latest/sensor_setup.calibra.description: Counter for customer calibration interval; range 0–30 days, default 0 days.

uvas_plus_sc@Latest/sensor_setup.configu.label: PARAMETER
uvas_plus_sc@Latest/sensor_setup.configu.description: Selectable parameters: SAK254, SAC254, Ext254, Abs254, T/cm, BODuv, BSBuv, CSBuv, CODuv, DOCuv, TOCuv, and others.

uvas_plus_sc@Latest/sensor_setup.configu.label: MEAS UNIT
uvas_plus_sc@Latest/sensor_setup.configu.description: Selectable units: 1/m, mE, AU, %, mg/l, ppm.

uvas_plus_sc@Latest/sensor_setup.configu.description: Two value pairs for converting SAC254 to a total parameter (e.g. TOC); format: 1[1/m] and 1[mg/l] — 2[1/m] and 2[mg/l].

uvas_plus_sc@Latest/sensor_setup.configu.label: REFERENCE
uvas_plus_sc@Latest/sensor_setup.configu.description: Enables or disables the reference channel; ON/OFF.

uvas_plus_sc@Latest/sensor_setup.configu.label: RESPONSE TIME
uvas_plus_sc@Latest/sensor_setup.configu.description: Range 1–12 × MEAS INTERVAL; displays the actual response time in minutes.

uvas_plus_sc@Latest/sensor_setup.configu.label: CLEANING
uvas_plus_sc@Latest/sensor_setup.configu.description: Wiper cleaning frequency; selectable: 1/measurement, 1, 2, 3, 5, 6, 10, 12, 15, 20, 30 min, 1, 2, 3, 4, 6, 12 h, 10:00h.

uvas_plus_sc@Latest/sensor_setup.configu.label: BYPASS
uvas_plus_sc@Latest/sensor_setup.configu.description: Enables bypass mode (yes/no); forces WIPER MODE to B and inhibits wiper extension.

uvas_plus_sc@Latest/sensor_setup.configu.label: SET DEFAULTS
uvas_plus_sc@Latest/sensor_setup.configu.description: Resets to factory configuration (MEAS INTERVAL: 5 min, RESPONSE TIME: 15 min, WIPER MODE: B-A-B).

uvas_plus_sc@Latest/sensor_setup.diag_te.label: REPLACE PROFILE
uvas_plus_sc@Latest/sensor_setup.diag_te.description: Initiates the wiper profile replacement procedure; see Changing wiper profile.

uvas_plus_sc@Latest/sensor_setup.diag_te.label: DRIVE OUT WIPER
uvas_plus_sc@Latest/sensor_setup.diag_te.description: Extends the wiper profile; inhibited on bypass versions.

uvas_plus_sc@Latest/sensor_setup.diag_te.label: MOTOR CURRENT
uvas_plus_sc@Latest/sensor_setup.diag_te.description: Displays motor current in mA during the wiping process.

uvas_plus_sc@Latest/sensor_setup.diag_te.label: SIGNALS
uvas_plus_sc@Latest/sensor_setup.diag_te.description: Displays live sensor signals at 1 measurement per second.

uvas_plus_sc@Latest/sensor_setup.diag_te.label: OUTPUT MODE
uvas_plus_sc@Latest/sensor_setup.diag_te.description: Defines the behaviour of instrument outputs when the MAINT.PROC. menu is opened.

uvas_plus_sc@Latest/sensor_setup.diag_te.description: Displays output mode information and maintenance procedures.
